ruleDefinitions.name: Sysinternals PsSuspend Suspicious Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious execution of Sysinternals PsSuspend, where the utility is used to suspend critical processes such as AV or EDR to bypass defenses

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "pssuspend\.exe" OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\pssuspend\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pssuspend64\\\.exe$"))) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*msmpeng\\\.exe.*"))
